description:
Predeclare and implement an argmin sweep protocol for extent fields, scoped to the twelve extent fields of the follow-on schema.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §5.1-§5.2 record why the standing crossover rule cannot sweep an extent field; task row T13 of §8 fixes the shape: an argmin search over a parameter grid at fixed operand sizes, the default kept on a tie or a non-monotone curve, the full grid recorded in the receipt.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed predeclaration fixes the extent-sweep rule - grid, argmin selection, tie and non-monotonicity handling, and receipt format - before any extent measurement exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: The calibration action implements the protocol for the twelve extent fields behind the explicit benchmark action, with no build side effect.
- [hard] REQ-03: Protocol runs record their grids and outcomes in the calibration receipt; an unswept field stays omitted from committed profiles under the standing omission rule.
title: Design and implement the extent-sweep protocol
